skills.name: Context-aware grep
skills.description: Search with context lines for faster comprehension.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Use file.search with narrow patterns.
2. Open hits with file.read around the line.
3. Prefer unique strings over generic ones.
4. Stop at the first definitive answer.

skills.name: Temp file management
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Prefix scratch files with tmp_.
2. Keep them inside the workspace.
3. Delete with file.delete when done.
4. Never leave tmp_ files in summaries.

skills.name: Read-only audit mode
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Use only file.list, file.read, file.search.
2. Report findings; change nothing.
3. Offer a fix plan at the end.
4. Confirm before any write.

skills.name: Incremental diff watching
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Snapshot relevant files with file.read hashes mentally.
2. After actions, re-read and compare.
3. Report precise deltas.
4. Avoid full-file dumps.

skills.name: Test data generation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Derive shapes from real samples (file.read).
2. Generate with python.run_file and fixed seeds.
3. Save under a fixtures folder.
4. Validate against the real parser.

skills.name: TODO-driven development
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Find TODOs with file.search.
2. Pick by impact; confirm with the user.
3. Implement with file.patch; remove the marker.
4. Test before moving on.

skills.name: Pair-programming mode
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Before each edit, say what and why in one line.
2. Apply with file.patch.
3. Show the diff region after.
4. Invite correction at decision points.

skills.name: Project skeleton generation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Confirm language and build tool (runtime.info).
2. Write manifests and entry points with file.write.
3. Build once to prove green (gradle.exec/make.exec/node.exec).
4. Add a README next.

skills.name: Contract test writing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Read the interface (file.read).
2. Test the contract, not the implementation.
3. Include failure contracts (what throws).
4. Run with gradle.exec/node.exec.

skills.name: Mock strategy
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify external edges (network, FS, clock).
2. Inject fakes at the boundary.
3. Keep fakes tiny and explicit.
4. Verify tests fail without the real thing wired.

skills.name: Coverage-guided fixes
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Run the test suite (gradle.exec).
2. List uncovered critical branches from the report.
3. Write targeted tests first there.
4. Re-run and compare.

skills.name: Lint baseline strategy
skills.description: Stop new debt, pay old debt gradually.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Run the linter once; capture the current issue set.
2. Enforce new code only.
3. Fix old issues opportunistically.
4. Track the shrinking baseline.

skills.name: Dependency upgrade path
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read current versions.
2. Check breaking changes via web.search.
3. Upgrade one major at a time.
4. Build + tests after each (gradle.exec).

skills.name: Backward compatibility care
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Enumerate callers (file.search).
2. Add, do not mutate; deprecate loudly.
3. Keep old behavior behind a flag if needed.
4. Test both paths.

skills.name: UTF-8 discipline
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Declare utf-8 at every file open (python.run_file).
2. Normalize at boundaries only.
3. Test with emoji and accents.
4. Verify output bytes when in doubt.

skills.name: Data class modeling
skills.description: Model domain data with data classes.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify repeated Map usage (file.search).
2. Introduce data classes with clear fields.
3. Patch call sites incrementally.
4. Build to verify.

skills.name: Sealed state modeling
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define a sealed hierarchy for states.
2. Handle all branches at usage sites.
3. Avoid nullable state combos.
4. Compile-verify with gradle.exec.

skills.name: Lightweight DI
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map current construction sites (file.search for constructors).
2. Centralize creation in one factory.
3. Pass dependencies explicitly.
4. Keep testability by interfaces.

skills.name: Gradle KTS tips
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the script; note syntax pitfalls.
2. Prefer version catalogs for coordinates.
3. Small incremental changes.
4. Validate with gradle.exec after each edit.

skills.name: Records and immutability
skills.description: Prefer immutable data carriers in Java.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Find mutable DTOs (file.search).
2. Convert to records where syntax allows.
3. Patch accessors usage.
4. Compile with javac.exec.

skills.name: Module hygiene in JS
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for circular import suspects.
2. Break cycles via interfaces/events.
3. Prefer default-free exports.
4. Verify with node.exec.

skills.name: Integer safety in C
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Audit arithmetic on sizes (file.read).
2. Use checked/width-specific types.
3. Compile with sanitizers via clang.exec.
4. Fix at the first overflow site.

skills.name: Buffer bounds discipline
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Find fixed-size buffers (file.search).
2. Pair every write with a bound check.
3. Prefer length-aware APIs.
4. Test edge sizes via a clang.exec-built harness.

skills.name: Iterator invalidation safety
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Locate container mutations in loops (file.read).
2. Re-acquire iterators after mutations.
3. Prefer algorithms over manual loops.
4. Build with clang.exec warnings.

skills.name: PHP security basics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read input handling.
2. Escape output contextually.
3. Use prepared statements; no string SQL.
4. Test with php.exec harness.

skills.name: Gem hygiene
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read Gemfile.
2. Pin versions; note native extensions.
3. Update one gem at a time.
4. Smoke-run with ruby.exec.

skills.name: Shell quoting mastery
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Find unquoted expansions (file.search).
2. Quote all variable uses.
3. Prefer arrays over string splitting.
4. Test with process.exec echo rounds.

skills.name: Idempotent scripts
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Guard each mutation with a condition.
2. Prefer create-if-missing over overwrite.
3. Log what was skipped.
4. Dry-run first with process.exec.

skills.name: View binding adoption
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Enable binding in gradle (file.patch).
2. Convert one layout at a time.
3. Patch usages; null-check per config.
4. Build with gradle.exec.

skills.name: Immersive mode handling
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Locate systemUiVisibility/WindowInsets usage (file.search).
2. Use WindowInsetsController APIs.
3. Handle cutouts.
4. Verify visually via android_screenshot.

skills.name: Haptic feedback wiring
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Check Vibrator usage patterns (file.search).
2. Use appropriate effect constants.
3. Respect system haptic settings.
4. Verify on device by feel/report.

skills.name: Edge-to-edge insets
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read window setup code.
2. Apply insets listeners to root views.
3. Pad content, not chrome.
4. Verify on notched devices via android_screenshot.

skills.name: Cold start optimization
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Trace Application.onCreate (file.read).
2. Move non-critical init off the main path.
3. Lazy-initialize heavy components.
4. Measure with startup logs.

skills.name: Configuration change resilience
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List retained state (file.search for statics).
2. Move to ViewModel/SavedStateHandle.
3. Test rotation via device automation.
4. Fix leaks found.

skills.name: Intent extras hardening
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Locate intent consumers (file.search).
2. Null-check and type-check every extra.
3. Fail closed with clear errors.
4. Test malformed intents.

skills.name: Exported component audit
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.apk.manifest to list exported components.
2. For each, ask if external access is required.
3. Tighten with android:exported=false or permissions.
4. Build and re-audit.

skills.name: Connection reuse basics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Observe handshakes in http.capture.
2. Enable keep-alive/pooling in the client.
3. Re-measure latency.
4. Report improvement.

skills.name: Timeout tuning
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List network calls (file.search).
2. Classify interactive vs batch.
3. Set connect/read/write timeouts accordingly.
4. Verify retry behavior.

skills.name: Offline-first checks
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Toggle airplane mode via device automation.
2. Exercise the app (androidclickelement).
3. Observe error handling (androidreadscreen).
4. Restore connectivity; verify recovery.

skills.name: Crawl etiquette
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Check robots.txt before web.crawl.
2. Cap depth and rate.
3. Identify yourself honestly if asked.
4. Stop on any block signal.

skills.name: Cache header design
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Inspect current Cache-Control (http.capture).
2. Classify resources by mutability.
3. Set max-age and validators accordingly.
4. Verify with repeat captures.

skills.name: API versioning checks
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Note version markers in captured traffic (http.history).
2. Check deprecation headers.
3. Test old-version behavior with http.replay.
4. Document the support window.

skills.name: Form edge testing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Enumerate fields (web.browser).
2. Submit boundary values via http.replay.
3. Observe validation messages.
4. Report gaps.

skills.name: Pagination testing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture page requests (http.capture).
2. Replay with off-by-one and huge offsets.
3. Check for duplicates/skips in data.
4. Report findings.

skills.name: Encoding pipeline design
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Choose one serialization per layer (file.read).
2. Write adapters at boundaries.
3. Test round-trips with python.run_file.
4. Document the pipeline.

skills.name: Time series handling
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Normalize timestamps to UTC (python.run_file).
2. Sort and de-dupe by key.
3. Aggregate with explicit windows.
4. Report gaps in coverage.

skills.name: Geospatial basics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Validate lat/lon ranges (python.run_file).
2. Mind datum/CRS differences.
3. Compute distances with the right formula.
4. Spot-check against known pairs.

skills.name: CI cache tuning
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read CI config cache blocks.
2. Cache dependencies, not artifacts of code.
3. Key caches precisely.
4. Verify via a second run.

skills.name: Secrets in pipelines
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search configs for inline secrets.
2. Move to secret managers/vars.
3. Rotate anything exposed.
4. Verify logs redact them.

skills.name: Environment documentation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture actual versions (runtime.info).
2. Write setup steps that match reality.
3. Include verification commands.
4. Test the doc on a clean path mentally.

skills.name: Incident note-taking
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Timeline with timestamps from logs.
2. Impact statement without speculation.
3. Evidence links (file paths).
4. Follow-ups with owners.

skills.name: Rollback planning
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify the previous good state (git.log).
2. Document revert steps.
3. Test rollback on a copy where possible.
4. Store the plan with file.write.

skills.name: Repacking assets
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.apktool.decode.
2. Replace asset files (file.write).
3. re.apktool.build; re.apk.sign.
4. Install via re.apk.install; verify.

skills.name: Manifest tooling
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. re.apk.manifest for a summary.
2. Cross-check with re.apktool.decode output.
3. Note discrepancies.
4. Report the merged truth.

skills.name: Analysis performance
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Prefer targeted queries over full dumps.
2. Cache analysis outputs in the workspace.
3. Re-run only on binary changes.
4. Note timings to tune approach.

skills.name: Evidence chaining
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Record tool+args for every finding.
2. Keep raw outputs in files (file.write).
3. Reference them in the report.
4. Re-run the chain before publishing.

skills.name: Scan session hygiene
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Limit region scope via mem.regions.
2. Stop scans at convergence.
3. Clear stale candidates between rounds.
4. Document final addresses.

skills.name: Value watching
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. mem.read the address periodically.
2. Record a small series.
3. Correlate with game events.
4. Summarize behavior.

skills.name: Type disambiguation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Scan as dword; scan as float.
2. Compare refinement speeds.
3. Verify with targeted mem.read.
4. Adopt the type that converges.

skills.name: Grouped edits
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map related addresses first.
2. Apply edits in one pass (mem.write).
3. Verify all took effect.
4. Roll back as a group if needed.

skills.name: Target stability checks
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. system.process_list before each write batch.
2. Detect pid changes (restarts).
3. Re-derive addresses after restarts.
4. Abort on instability.

skills.name: Log file rotation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Check log size (file.list).
2. Archive old logs with process.exec mv.
3. Compress if useful.
4. Keep the live log small.

skills.name: Battery drain investigation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. dumpsys batterystats via process.exec.
2. Identify top wakelock holders.
3. Correlate with app usage.
4. Recommend fixes.

skills.name: Storage hog identification
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. df and du via process.exec (root where needed).
2. Rank consumers.
3. Relate to apps/caches.
4. Propose safe cleanups.

skills.name: ANR analysis
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Pull traces via root.exec (data/anr).
2. Identify the blocked thread.
3. Map to code with file.search.
4. Propose the fix.

skills.name: Wakelock audit
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. dumpsys power via process.exec.
2. Note long-held wakeups.
3. Map to features.
4. Recommend batching.

skills.name: Sync diagnostics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. dumpsys content via process.exec.
2. Check sync status per authority.
3. Capture sync traffic (http.capture).
4. Locate the failing step.

skills.name: Certificate pinning awareness
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Note TLS failures under capture (http.capture).
2. Conclude pinning when handshakes fail only under MITM.
3. Do not bypass without authorization.
4. Document the finding.

skills.name: Feature discovery in apps
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. androidreadscreen systematically.
2. Open every menu (androidclickelement).
3. Note hidden/advanced toggles.
4. Summarize the feature map.

skills.name: App version comparison
skills.description: Compare two app versions by use.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Note versions (system.app_list).
2. Drive identical flows on both (androidclickelement).
3. Compare behavior and screens.
4. Report deltas.

skills.name: Boot time analysis
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. root.exec dumpsys with boot events.
2. Extract timing checkpoints.
3. Identify slow services.
4. Report with numbers.

skills.name: Thermal state awareness
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. dumpsys thermals via process.exec.
2. Note throttle levels during heavy work.
3. Pace long tasks.
4. Report thermal status with results.

skills.name: Per-app language
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. android.app_settings for the target app.
2. androidclickelement Language.
3. Pick the language; verify.
4. Note app restart behavior.

skills.name: Work profile awareness
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. system.app_list shows profile badges.
2. Note which side an app lives on.
3. Use the right context for automation.
4. Explain separation to the user.

skills.name: Guest mode handling
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Open quick settings user tile (androidclickelement).
2. Switch to guest on request.
3. Note data separation.
4. Switch back when done.

skills.name: Checklist execution
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Render the checklist in chat.
2. Execute items in order; tick as done.
3. Report exceptions immediately.
4. Close with the final state.

skills.name: Double-check pass
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Re-run the core verification command.
2. Re-read the critical file sections.
3. Compare against the acceptance criteria.
4. Only then report success.

skills.name: Failure postmortem
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Describe what was attempted.
2. State the exact failure evidence.
3. Propose the next hypothesis.
4. Record durable lessons via memory.save.

skills.name: Update cadence
skills.description: Keep the user informed at the right rate.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Update on phase changes and blockers, not every tool call.
2. Keep updates one line.
3. Include current step / total.
4. Finish with a clear status.

skills.name: Artifact indexing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Collect produced file paths (file.list).
2. file.write an index with descriptions.
3. Reference the index in the summary.
4. Keep it updated on changes.

skills.name: Personal cheatsheets
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Record successful tool invocations in a notes file.
2. Group by task type.
3. Reuse patterns next time.
4. Prune stale entries.
